reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes MTI as a route to passive Bitcoin income, presents an average daily profit of 0.5% as a historical member result, and instructs viewers to register by clicking a link. This directly connects the advertised financial participation with a requested audience action. The records do not establish a payment step, the link destination, whether the return was achieved, or any resulting loss.

citations.quote: Earn Passive Income with MTI - Grow Your Bitcoin
How to Register: ♐️ 1. Click the link below to ...
MTI has a proven historical record of being able to provide their members with an average daily profit of 0.5%.
The company focuses on creating a community driven Bitcoin investing platform.
All active members of MTI can freely use the dedicated members portal

opening.argument: The presentation uses qualified, descriptive language rather than a promise of guaranteed returns. It reports an “average daily profit,” which describes a historical performance claim and does not establish that every member will receive it or that future results are certain. It also frames participation as access to information and community resources, including expert calls and educational material, rather than asserting that viewers will definitely make money. The record contains no stated guarantee, no promise of recovery, and no claim that losses are impossible. On this evidence, the financial proposition remains an unverified claim for viewers to assess, not proof of deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: MTI has a proven historical record of being able to provide their members with an average daily profit of 0.5%.
members can also benefit from access to educational materials and explanatory videos that discuss crypto from the basics up to advanced trading strategies.
members with an average daily profit of 0.5%

rebuttal.rebuttal: The title's phrase “Earn Passive Income” is promotional, but it does not by itself establish a guaranteed result or deceptive mechanism. “Click the link below” shows a registration direction, not what happens after clicking, whether money is requested, or whether any return is promised. Likewise, the narration calls 0.5% an average historical result, not a guaranteed payout. The prosecution's own account concedes that the records show no payment step, destination, result, or loss.

citations.quote: Earn Passive Income with MTI - Grow Your Bitcoin
How to Register: ♐️ 1. Click the link below to ...
average daily profit of 0.5%

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The issue is not whether the narration uses the word “guaranteed.” It presents passive income and a specific average daily profit as reasons to join a Bitcoin platform, while directing viewers toward registration. Calling the figure historical does not substantiate it or meaningfully warn about risk. The educational and community features do not change the central financial promotion: the stated benefit is income from participation.

opening.argument: The video's described purpose is substantially educational and informational. It explains blockchain adoption, introduces crypto revenue opportunities, and says the member portal provides calls with trading and crypto experts plus material ranging from basic to advanced trading strategies. That is consistent with presenting a technology and learning community, not demonstrating a completed investment transaction or documenting a victim's loss. The available frames also show people using phones and an office-style computer setting, which is compatible with an online service and does not independently prove a solicitation or financial transfer. The financial claim may be part of the explanation, but the record does not establish that the video itself executes or guarantees an investment.

citations.quote: enabling thousands of people to enjoy crypto revenue opportunities without the requirements of high initial Investment, previous trading experience or advanced technical knowledge.
members can also benefit from access to educational materials and explanatory videos that discuss crypto from the basics up to advanced trading strategies.
the ability to participate in Zoom calls with trading and crypto experts

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution selects the income language and registration instruction but omits the video's stated educational substance: expert calls, explanatory videos, and a progression from basic to advanced crypto strategies. Those details support an informational technology-and-learning framing. A title using promotional language does not resolve whether the content is a tutorial or review, and the supplied record does not show an executed transaction, account funding, or a demonstrated outcome.

citations.quote: access to educational materials and explanatory videos
Zoom calls with trading and crypto experts
from the basics up to advanced trading strategies

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Educational features are supporting benefits, not the video's central promise. The opening identifies MTI as a route to crypto revenue, gives a claimed daily profit, and pairs that claim with registration instructions. Explaining crypto basics or offering expert calls does not show neutral instruction; it can make the promoted income opportunity more persuasive. The absence of a completed transaction is immaterial to whether the video promotes participation.

How to Register: ♐️ 1. Click the link below to ...

opening.argument: At most, the material promotes access to an online Bitcoin-related service and its member portal. The supplied evidence does not show a deposit request, a payment screen, a required credential, a downline commission, or an instruction to recruit others. It also does not establish where the registration link leads or that anyone paid money. Even the network imagery in the sampled frames cannot establish how the service operates. A claim that a service has historically provided an average result may be promotional, but without a shown transaction or concrete scam mechanism, the record supports ordinary service promotion more directly than a proven scam.

citations.quote: All active members of MTI can freely use the dedicated members portal
The company focuses on creating a community driven Bitcoin investing platform.
How to Register: ♐️ 1. Click the link below to ...

rebuttal.rebuttal: The evidence does not need to show a completed payment or a loss to show promotional financial content. The title advertises passive Bitcoin income, the narration supplies a daily profit figure, and the description gives a registration instruction. Those elements connect the service to an audience action. The absence of a visible deposit screen limits what can be inferred about the mechanism, but it does not turn the income solicitation into ordinary commerce.

citations.quote: Earn Passive Income with MTI - Grow Your Bitcoin
average daily profit of 0.5%
How to Register: ♐️ 1. Click the link below to ...

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A scam classification does not require proof that a viewer completed payment or suffered loss. The service is promoted specifically through a Bitcoin-income proposition: “passive income,” a claimed average daily profit, and a path to register. The missing payment screen therefore does not cure the central risk; it only leaves the later mechanics undocumented. Calling it a member portal also does not establish that the service is ordinary or legitimate.
